pcs.pc_description: make sure the machine is kept clean at all times, before loading, while running & after unloading the fabric
follow the preventive maintenance schedule of the machine is running smoothly
check that all controls are functioning properly
ensure the right quality of water, steam & air is available for proper functioning of machine
cool down the machine after completion of job
ensure working of metal detector and its sensitivity
check oil pressure and level in hydraulic unit
report to his work place well before time to meet the previous shift operator
discuss with him the process running on the machine
check if the machine is running smoothly & has any breakdown in previous shift
check for any quality issues in the fabric running on the machine

modules.module_title: Taking out the sample after calendaring & comparing it with the standard

pcs.pc_description: taking out the sample after calendaring near the stitch
compare the sample with the standard
take the sample to your supervisor if the sample is not matching to the standard for decision
adjust the roller pressure, temp or machine speed to match the required feel & finish as advised by the supervisor
